productsAndServices.description: A metal tile roofing product with enhanced mechanical strength, designed to resemble classic ceramic tiles, offering heat reduction, noise reduction, water condensation absorption, corrosion protection, and fire resistance.
productsAndServices.name: Țiglă metalică Nobel SMART (Nobel SMART Metal Tile)

productsAndServices.description: An online tool to select metal tile models, finishes, colors, and roof types, and to calculate roofing material requirements and accessories for a given roof.
productsAndServices.name: Calculator acoperiș (Roof Calculator)

productsAndServices.description: A range of roof windows with various sizes, glazing options, and operation types, designed to provide ventilation, natural light, and energy efficiency in roof spaces.
productsAndServices.name: Ferestre Velux (Velux Windows)

productsAndServices.description: A vapor-permeable, water-resistant membrane used under roofing to protect the structure from water infiltration and condensation damage.
productsAndServices.name: Folie anticondens (Anti-condensation Membrane)

productsAndServices.description: Metal vertical fencing systems available in multiple sizes, colors, and thicknesses, designed for protection and easy maintenance.
productsAndServices.name: Garduri verticale Caretta (Caretta Vertical Fences)

productsAndServices.description: Metal roofing accessories including ridge caps, gutters, valleys, flashing, and ventilation elements used to complete and seal roofing systems.
